```yaml
---
id: vuln-openssh-key-parser-26e0a471
pattern:
  - from: openssh_key.pascal_style_byte_stream
    function: read_fixed_bytes
    args:
      num_bytes: int
    body:
      - raise EOFError(read_bytes)
languages: [python]
message: Vulnerable use of EOFError in OpenSSH key parser
severity: ERROR
metadata:
  cwe: CWE-209
  cvss: 7.5
  description: |
    The `read_fixed_bytes` function in the `PascalStyleByteStream` class
    raises an `EOFError` when fewer than `num_bytes` bytes are read from
    the underlying bytestream. This can lead to a denial of service attack
    if an attacker can control the input data and manipulate the number of
    bytes read.
  remediation: |
    To fix this vulnerability, replace the `raise EOFError(read_bytes)`
    statement with `raise EOFError("Fewer than 'num_bytes' bytes remaining in the "
                    "underlying bytestream")`. This will raise a more informative
    error message that does not reveal sensitive information.
  references:
    - https://github.com/openssh/openssh-portable/issues/26e0a471
```
